tweets.text:
I'm not interested in trading bounces during a medium-term downtrend.

I'm not saying it's right or wrong. It's simply not my business.

I know my strengths and weaknesses extremely well. I know how to ride trends until they become exhausted, and I've been demonstrating that since 2017/18.

My business is buying and selling at extremes.

That doesn't mean I always catch the exact top or bottom. But when I finally pull the trigger, there's usually very little room left for the trend to continue.

Most people think being successful in this market means trading every single move.

I completely disagree.

In my experience, there are maybe 1 or 2 truly worthwhile opportunities per year.

The rest is mostly noise.

And here's what most people don't understand:

The time between one extreme and the next is exactly where people lose their minds.

They get impatient. They chase moves. They overtrade. They convince themselves they're missing opportunities.

Meanwhile, I'm perfectly comfortable doing absolutely nothing.

Patience is part of my strategy, not a lack of one.

If you understand this approach and want to follow my analysis more closely, join the @AlphaDoctrine_x  waitlist.

It closes in 12 days.

https://alphadoctrine.io

We keep going.

tweets.text:
A lot of people, both on and off X, keep asking me the same question:

What's your honest outlook on crypto?

And the truth is, I think most people aren't ready for my answer.

1. Don't expect anything remotely similar to what we've experienced over the past few years. That era is over.

2. We're entering an entirely new paradigm driven by AI. Capital, attention, and investment priorities are shifting.

3. Crypto cycles won't behave the way they used to. Those blindly relying on historical patterns and the traditional four-year cycle are going to get burned.

4. Most of the major milestones crypto was supposed to achieve have already happened. ETFs, institutional adoption, mainstream recognition. It's becoming increasingly difficult to generate the same level of excitement through new narratives.

5. Crypto isn't dead. But I genuinely believe the way we've experienced crypto cycles is.

And here's what I think very few people understand:

The next decade won't necessarily reward the people who made money in the last one.

The market is evolving, and the strategies that worked before may become completely irrelevant.

I expect a much more selective market, with capital increasingly concentrated in a smaller number of projects that actually deliver value.

The days when almost everything pumped simply because Bitcoin was going up may be coming to an end.

Crypto isn't disappearing.

It's maturing.

And I believe that transition will be incredibly painful for those who refuse to adapt.

Hope you understand.

The next decade won't necessarily reward the people who made money in the last one.

The market is evolving, and the strategies that worked before may become completely irrelevant.

I expect a much more selective market, with capital increasingly concentrated in a smaller number of projects that actually deliver value.

The days when almost everything pumped simply because Bitcoin was going up may be coming to an end.

Crypto isn't disappearing.

It's maturing.

And I believe that transition will be incredibly painful for those who refuse to adapt.

Hope you understand.

I believe this will be the longest bear market in Bitcoin's history.

And the truth is, nobody knows exactly how long it will last.

I hope you're prepared for anything.

The purge will be massive.

Projects will disappear. Entire communities will collapse. And many influencers who look like millionaires on paper today could end up losing everything.

I believe this painful process is exactly what crypto needs.

A complete reset. A market where speculation gives way to real value, and only the strongest projects survive.

And ironically, I think this purge could lay the foundations for one of the biggest crypto cycles we've ever seen.

But first, the market needs to clean itself out.

The next great opportunity will be born from the destruction of this cycle.

Hope you understand.
